by
  let f := fun n => Real.exp (-↑r) * ↑r ^ n / ↑n.factorial
  let s := ∑' f
  have h : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n := by intro n; simp [Real.exp_nonneg, zero_le_one, mul_nonneg, pow_nonneg, inv_nonneg, zero_le_factorial]
  have h_sum : HasSum f (Real.exp (-↑r) * ∑' (fun n => ↑r ^ n / ↑n.factorial))
  let h_exp : HasSum (fun n => ↑r ^ n / ↑n.factorial) (exp r) := by apply exp_series_has_sum
  rw [h_exp] at h_sum
  rw [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_one] at h_sum
  exact h_sum
